name: fable
title_zh: 本地 Fable 5.1 当总指挥
tagline_zh: 你喊一声 $fable，它用本地已验证的 Fable 5.1 拆任务。
tagline_en: Invoke $fable: local Fable 5.1 plans and delegates to GPT-5.6 Luna or DeepSeek V4 Flash. Keep orchestration.
desc_en: Use the locally authenticated Claude Code Fable 5.1 model only as the orchestrator for a task, then execute implementation with GPT-5.6 Luna or DeepSeek V4 Flash. Use when the user invokes $fable or asks Fable to orchestrate Codex agents.
why_zh: 编排与执行分离：本地模型掌控任务分解和调度，外部模型只做实现。既保住你对流程的掌控。
why_en: Separates orchestration from execution: local model owns planning and dispatch, external models only implement. You keep control.
limit_zh: 只认 Claude Code 里已登录的 Fable 5.1；没装或没登录就直接停。只覆盖编排层。
limit_en: Requires authenticated Fable 5.1 in Claude Code; stops if missing. Orchestration only—implementation quality depends entirely on GPT-5.6/DeepSeek.
